subtopics.name: Meaning, Scope and Functions of Commerce
objectives: Define commerce and explain its scope
Identify the divisions of commerce (trade and aids to trade)
Explain the functions and importance of commerce to economic development
Trace the historical development of commerce in Nigeria

subtopics.name: Commerce and Related Disciplines
objectives: Relate commerce to other subjects (economics, accounting, marketing)
Explain the interrelationship between production, trade and aids to trade

subtopics.name: Types and Classification of Occupations
objectives: Classify occupations into industrial, commercial and service occupations
Distinguish between extractive, manufacturing and constructive industries
Identify factors that determine choice of occupation

subtopics.name: Division of Labour and Specialization
objectives: Explain division of labour and specialization in occupations
State the advantages and disadvantages of division of labour
Explain the limitations of division of labour

subtopics.name: Factors and Types of Production
objectives: Define production and identify its types (direct and indirect)
Describe the factors of production and their rewards
Distinguish between production of goods and services

subtopics.name: Scale of Production
objectives: Distinguish between small-scale and large-scale production
Explain internal and external economies of scale
Identify factors determining the scale of production

subtopics.name: Retail Trade
objectives: Define retailing and identify types of retailers (small-scale and large-scale)
Describe the functions of retailers in the chain of distribution
Explain modern retailing trends (supermarkets, chain stores, e-tailing, vending machines)
State the factors to consider in setting up a retail business

subtopics.name: Wholesale Trade and Channels of Distribution
objectives: Define wholesaling and identify types of wholesalers
Describe the functions of wholesalers to producers, retailers and consumers
Explain the channels of distribution and reasons for eliminating middlemen

subtopics.name: Basics of Foreign Trade
objectives: Distinguish between home trade and foreign trade
Explain import, export and entrepot trade
State the advantages and disadvantages of foreign trade
Identify barriers to international trade and instruments of protection

subtopics.name: Balance of Trade, Balance of Payments and Trade Documents
objectives: Distinguish between balance of trade and balance of payments
Identify documents used in foreign trade (bill of lading, certificate of origin, letters of credit, indent)
Explain the roles of customs authority and ports in foreign trade
Explain the role of ECOWAS in West African trade

subtopics.name: Procedure and Documents of Purchase and Sale
objectives: Describe the stages in the purchase and sale of goods
Identify documents used in buying and selling (enquiry, quotation, order, invoice, proforma invoice, credit note, debit note, receipt, statement of account)
Interpret common trade abbreviations (E&OE, COD, CWO, FOB, CIF)

subtopics.name: Terms of Trade and Payment
objectives: Distinguish between trade discount, quantity discount and cash discount
Explain terms of payment: cash, credit, hire purchase and deferred payment
Distinguish between hire purchase and deferred payment

subtopics.name: Advertising and Communication
objectives: Define advertising and identify its types and media
State the advantages and disadvantages of advertising
Explain the role of communication in commerce and types of communication services

subtopics.name: Banking and Insurance
objectives: Explain the role of banking as an aid to trade
Define insurance and explain its principles (utmost good faith, insurable interest, indemnity, subrogation, contribution, proximate cause)
Identify types of insurance policies relevant to business
Distinguish between insurance and assurance

subtopics.name: Transportation, Warehousing and Tourism
objectives: Identify modes of transportation with their advantages and disadvantages
Explain the importance of transportation to commerce
Define warehousing and identify types of warehouses and their functions
Explain tourism as an aid to trade and its economic importance

subtopics.name: Sole Proprietorship and Partnership
objectives: Describe the features, advantages and disadvantages of sole proprietorship
Describe partnership: formation, types of partners, partnership deed
State the advantages and disadvantages of partnership

subtopics.name: Limited Liability Companies
objectives: Distinguish between private and public limited companies
Describe the formation of companies and documents required (memorandum and articles of association, prospectus, certificate of incorporation)
State the advantages and disadvantages of limited liability companies

subtopics.name: Cooperative Societies and Public Enterprises
objectives: Describe types of cooperative societies and their functions
Describe public corporations: features, advantages and disadvantages
Explain privatization, commercialization and indigenization in Nigeria

subtopics.name: Sources of Business Finance
objectives: Identify sources of finance: personal savings, loans, overdrafts, trade credit, hire purchase, leasing
Distinguish between short-term, medium-term and long-term finance
Explain the role of microfinance banks in financing small businesses

subtopics.name: Business Securities
objectives: Distinguish between shares (ordinary and preference), stocks, debentures and bonds
Explain the rights of holders of each type of security
Distinguish between profits and dividends

topics.name: Trade Associations and Chambers of Commerce

subtopics.name: Trade and Manufacturer Associations
objectives: Define trade associations and state their objectives and functions
Explain the roles of manufacturers' associations (e.g. MAN)

subtopics.name: Chambers of Commerce
objectives: Describe the functions of chambers of commerce
Explain the roles of NACCIMA and international chambers of commerce

subtopics.name: Evolution, Characteristics and Functions of Money
objectives: Trace the evolution of money from trade by barter and the problems of barter
State the characteristics and functions of money
Identify forms of money and legal tender in Nigeria

subtopics.name: Value of Money and Inflation
objectives: Explain the value of money and factors affecting it
Explain inflation and deflation and their effects on commerce

subtopics.name: Operations of the Stock Exchange
objectives: Define the stock exchange and describe its functions
Describe the procedure for buying and selling securities
Explain the roles of operators: stockbrokers, jobbers, bulls, bears and stags

subtopics.name: Securities and the Second-Tier Securities Market
objectives: Identify securities traded on the stock exchange
Explain the requirements for quotation on the Nigerian Stock Exchange
Explain the second-tier securities market and its importance to small companies

subtopics.name: Functions and Principles of Management
objectives: Identify the functions of management: planning, organizing, staffing, directing, coordinating, controlling
Explain basic principles of management (span of control, unity of command, delegation of authority)

subtopics.name: Organizational Structure and Business Resources
objectives: Describe types of organizational structure (line, staff, functional, matrix)
Identify business resources: man, money, materials, machines
Explain the functional areas of a business (production, marketing, finance, personnel)

subtopics.name: Marketing Concepts and Functions
objectives: Define marketing and explain the marketing concept
Describe the functions of marketing
Explain market segmentation and its bases

subtopics.name: The Marketing Mix and Marketing Research
objectives: Explain the elements of the marketing mix (product, price, place, promotion)
Explain product life cycle, branding and packaging

subtopics.name: Contract and Sale of Goods
objectives: Define a contract and identify the elements of a valid contract

Explain the principle of caveat emptor

subtopics.name: Agency, Hire Purchase and Consumer Protection
objectives: Define agency and explain the creation and termination of agency
Explain the rights and duties of principal and agent
Explain the legal aspects of hire purchase
Identify instruments of consumer protection in Nigeria (SON, NAFDAC, CPC/FCCPC)

topics.name: Information and Communication Technology in Commerce

subtopics.name: ICT Tools and Applications in Business
objectives: Identify ICT tools used in commerce (computers, internet, POS, ATM, mobile devices)
Explain the uses of ICT in banking, marketing and trade
State the advantages and challenges of ICT in Nigerian commerce

subtopics.name: E-Commerce and E-Banking
objectives: Define e-commerce and identify its types (B2B, B2C, C2C)
Explain e-banking services and electronic means of payment
State the advantages and disadvantages of e-commerce

subtopics.name: The Business Environment
objectives: Identify the elements of the business environment (economic, political, legal, social, technological)

subtopics.name: Social Responsibility of Business
objectives: Define social responsibility and identify the responsibilities of business to its stakeholders
